This website presents interactive disease notification-rate information by
Australian local government area (LGA).

Select a disease from the panel on the left to open its disease-specific page.
Where multiple years are available, use the year selector to switch between
them.

Interactive disease pages may include two views:

- **Map:** zoom, pan and hover over an LGA to view its notification rate.
  
- **Data table:** search, sort and filter the notification rates by
  LGA, state or territory, and year of diagnosis.
